kennismaking.description_en: A short video call about your location and what you need. No obligation.

dronefotografie.description_en: One building or site. Fifteen to twenty-five edited photos, usage rights for web and social.

dronevideo.description_en: The same shoot, plus an edited clip of thirty to forty-five seconds.

bedrijfsfilm.description_en: A sixty to ninety second film about your site or project. Music and voice-over by arrangement.

bouwvordering.description_en: Fixed route and fixed altitude, every month. A discount applies from four visits.

project-op-maat.description_en: Several locations or several days. You book an intro call; the form asks up front about the locations and the period.

herenhuis-aan-de-zaan.title_en: Detached house on the River Zaan
herenhuis-aan-de-zaan.summary_en: Aerial photos of a detached house, made for an estate agent's brochure.
herenhuis-aan-de-zaan.body_en:
The estate agent wanted to show how the house sits on the water and how far the garden runs back. You can't capture that from the ground.

I flew in the last hour before sunset, so the water lies still and the façade catches warm light. Twelve photos were delivered: a series of overviews and a few detail shots of the roof and the extension.

The images were used in the brochure, on the property portal and in the social media ads.
herenhuis-aan-de-zaan.cover_alt_en: Example image: aerial photo of a detached house with a garden by the water

nieuwbouwwijk-in-aanbouw.summary_en: Monthly progress shots of a new-build project, always from the same point.
nieuwbouwwijk-in-aanbouw.body_en:
A developer wanted the construction of 48 homes recorded, so buyers could follow the progress.

Every month I flew the same route at the same altitude. That makes the images easy to compare and a series builds up by itself.

The photos were on the project website and were used at the end for a short look-back video.
nieuwbouwwijk-in-aanbouw.cover_alt_en: Example image: aerial photo of a housing estate under construction

bedrijventerrein-achtersluispolder.summary_en: Atmosphere and overview shots of a logistics site for the new company website.
bedrijventerrein-achtersluispolder.body_en:
The company moved to a larger building and wanted images of it for the website and an investor presentation.

We flew on a quiet Saturday morning, so there was no lorry traffic on the site. Besides overviews I made a few lower passes along the façade.

Delivered: eight photos and a forty-second edit.
bedrijventerrein-achtersluispolder.cover_alt_en: Example image: aerial photo of a business park

productielocatie-in-bedrijf.summary_en: Images of a production site, used in a recruitment campaign for new colleagues.
productielocatie-in-bedrijf.body_en:
A recruitment campaign needed images showing how large the site is and how the work is done.

We agreed in advance with management which parts could and could not be shown. During the flight a colleague kept watch on the ground.

The images were used on the vacancies page and in short videos for social media.
productielocatie-in-bedrijf.cover_alt_en: Example image: aerial photo of a production site

veenweide-bij-zonsopkomst.summary_en: Personal work: a series of landscape images of the peat meadows in the early morning.
veenweide-bij-zonsopkomst.body_en:
This is my own work, made to practise with light and composition in open landscape.

The images were made in the half hour after sunrise, when mist still hangs over the water. I flew low and slow, so the lines of the ditches come out well.

Part of this series hangs as prints in my workspace.
veenweide-bij-zonsopkomst.cover_alt_en: Example image: aerial photo of peat meadows in the morning mist
